question: In which Olympics did Khashaba Jadhav, the first Indian win an individual Olympic medal for India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1952 Helsinki Olympics**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** 1952 Helsinki Olympics**

 
 
• KD Jadhav was Independent India's first Individual Olympic medalist.
 
• He won a Bronze medal in the 1952 Helsinki (Finland) Olympics in Wrestling.
 
• Independent India's first Olympic medal was a gold medal won by the Indian Hockey Team in the 1952 Helsinki Olympics.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** 1972 Munich Olympics**

 
 
• Munich was the host city for the 1972 Summer Olympic Games.
 
• The games were held from August 26 to September 11, 1972.
 
• These Olympics are particularly remembered for the tragic Munich massacre, where 11 Israeli athletes and coaches were taken hostage and killed by Palestinian terrorists.
 
• Despite the tragedy, the games continued, and athletes from around the world competed in various events.
 
 
 
• **1948 London Olympics**
 
 
• Independent India won its first Olympic Gold for hockey in 1948 just a year after independence
 
• The 1948 Olympics took place in Wembley Park in London
 
• India in total took part in 39 events throughout 10 sports and came home with the single gold medal
 
• India won its maiden medal by defeating Great Britain 4-0 in the finals 
 
 
 
• **1936 Berlin Olympics**
 
 
• In the 1936 Berlin Olympics he was the captain, and India defeated Germany 8-1 in the final to win their third consecutive gold medal.
 
• Chand scored three goals in the match, and he was named the player of the tournament.
